note: SCB 47.52 decelerating to +3.9% in August against a share gap that widened three quarters running puts Q3 sales below the SEK 2,049M consensus on a 2-analyst name that fell 15.7% on a 5% sales miss a year ago; gross margin and Clas Ohlson's September offset part of it.

The unremarked 8% cut to Pantheon's revenue budget between the April and September RNSs, plus 36.29p of dividends out, makes a flat-to-lower HY NAV per share likely, but nine observed NAV prints moved this stock a median 1.9% and even a +42% NAV year paid 2.07%, so the move is small whatever the mark.

Eurex's Q3 volumes (and a September release dated after part of the consensus window) sit above the 339 Financial Derivatives mean, but with 14 analysts, consensus already above every FY26 guided line and the stock at a record 98% of target, the offsetting risk that a raise is the bar leaves this near zero.

The toughest comp of the year (Q3-25 organic 7%, P&NO +13%) against a consensus implying ~6% organic, with Q2's USD 3m tariff refund gone by the CFO's own statement; item 8 (consensus Q3 sales below Q2 when Q3 normally runs above) is a sourced counter-fact and was dropped as a duplicate when it is not one, so I file it positive.

A regulated 9M print inside a reaffirmed guide with 20 analysts: the Teréga debt is arithmetic everyone can do and the CNMC framework was paid at the draft (+17.0%) and ignored at final approval (-0.12%), so the only unpriced item is a possible first company figure for 2027 revenue, which may not come until the H1 2027 plan.

Management promised to quantify Amesto cost synergies in this very release and no estimate holds a number for it, on a 2-analyst name whose real report days have moved +11.4% and -12.7%; the bar is genuinely unsourced so everything is capped, and I reinstate item 7 (Cinode/Realtid consulting slowdown) as a small negative because no primary document was named against it.

Two mechanical, independently sourced reasons reported ARR lands at the top of or above the 10-11% broker bar (SEK translation on 31% of revenue, and a Q3-25 sequential add of only +9.1 MSEK against +15.8/+17.3 this year) on the one line this stock has moved +17.9% and -21.6% on; the July order-intake caution is the offset.

This release is MuM's scheduled first guide for next year (2023, 2024, 2025 precedent), which is why abs_move is high, and the documented record of reaffirming and then missing the annual target twice against an H2 that now needs +18-36% EBIT tilts the sign slightly down; the quarter itself should be clean on the lapsed Autodesk base effect.

FY results carrying the first FY27 guide on a name with 59% sixty-day vol that has paid -20.3%, -16.7% and -13.6% on guide and capex events: the FY27 capex/levered-FCF number does not exist yet and a RAM index at 604 points it the wrong way, with the Oct price rises the offset and a -21.5% twenty-day slide meaning part of the negative is already in.

The bar was lifted ~15% in thirty days so the trend beat is now in the number and this name has sold its small beats intraday, against which the Lusiaves/Lantmannen/Qviberg contest for a thin float is real support only visible in the Swedish register and press; net close to nothing.

The first full quarter with no Aira cost plus the Swedish Q3 cost dip is arithmetic, not a guess, and should print EBITDA far above the >35% guide on a name with no real coverage, but the only estimate already models it and ARR, the line that has been sold twice, is the swing; the absent MAR pre-release argues against a blowout.
